about: The first three exchanges are Psalm 84:7–8 and Psalm 101:2 in the Vulgate numbering, from the Gallican psalter the Mass uses: it opens the first of them Deus, tu convérsus where later editions read Nonne tu convérsus. The last is the liturgical greeting “Dóminus vobíscum” and its response.

seg.tr: O God, You will turn toward us and give us life.
And Your people will rejoice in You.
Show us Your mercy, O Lord.
And let my cry come to You.

ex.w032: In the greeting “Dóminus vobíscum”, Latin leaves the verb unspoken: “the Lord [is] with you”.
